headline: BB to Issue Tk32,000cr Sukuk in FY27 to strengthen Islamic banking liquidity
summary: Bangladesh Bank Deputy Governor Md Kabir Ahmed said the planned sukuk issuance would expand financing for businesses and infrastructure. It would also strengthen the country's Islamic finance market and banking liquidity.
why: Sukuk are Shariah-compliant bonds, and government issuance of them deepens Islamic finance markets and gives banks liquid instruments.
